bureau.title: Our Office
bureau.about1: LEF-T is a structural engineering office based in Paris, in the heart of the dynamic Belleville district.
bureau.about2: Specializing in lightweight structures and facades, we work on innovative projects in France and Germany.
bureau.about3: Our strength lies in our ability to design tailor-made solutions.
bureau.about4: Although a small structure, our team is responsive, flexible and committed.
